sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: a true outlier for fruit fat quality. This behaves nothing like typical sweet fruit and that makes the category result exceptional. Easy to use as a whole food. Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating. Brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: The drawbacks next: calorie density is much higher than most fruits. Still useful, but it changes how casually you can throw it in. Can be easy to waste if timing is off.
